item.title: Design and numerical performance analysis of efficient Ag3TaX4 (X = S, Se, Te) thin film solar cells
item.description: arXiv:2608.24301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silver-based ternary chalcogenides have recently emerged as promising absorber materials for thin film photovoltaics. Nevertheless, their photovoltaic performance in complete device architectures has not yet been systematically explored. In this work, three-dimensional (3D) n-CdS/p-Ag3TaX4 (X = S, Se, Te)/p+-GeS thin-film solar cells have been designed and numerically investigated using the Semiconductor Module of COMSOL Multiphysics.
